main_body: multi-story brick townhouse with mansard slate roof
top_band: grey/blue-grey roof top surface and sloped slate shingles from rows 16 to 43, capped by an orange cornice at rows 44-45
evidence: The building shows a distinct mansard roof section (rows 16-43) with a flat top platform and tiled slope above the cornice (rows 44-45) and eave shadow (rows 46-47), sitting over a 3-story brick front face (rows 48-143) with recessed windows and doorway.

style.evidence: The brickwork, slate roof tiles, and window reflections feature 5-6 value steps per material, rich per-brick and per-tile texture, and dark material-tinted outlines matching the density and craft of the reference buildings.
